content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 21.1 (with conforming edit to § 21.3), targeted at the preferred position.

- **Defect:** the mutual cap of one month's "Fees actually paid" applied "without exception" both fell below the walk-away floor (under 6 months' fees) and nullified the otherwise-good Excluded Claims regime in §§ 21.2–21.3, leaving indemnities, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside a one-month cap.
- **Cure (2 ops):** (1) § 21.1 becomes "Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000" — lowercase "fees" avoids the narrow § 1.5 definition; (2) § 21.3's payment carve-out noun broadened from defined "Fees" to "amounts due", keeping the "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" qualifiers intact.
- **Already met:** § 21.2's mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages was left untouched.
